value.body: A finance and accounts (F&A) process associate handles one part of a company's accounting in a structured process — such as paying suppliers, recording customer receipts, or reconciling ledgers. Accounting outsourcing firms and the shared-service centres of large companies hire them in large numbers. Work runs on monthly cycles, with the busiest days around month-end close.

items.label: Common tools
items.value: An ERP system, Excel, ticketing tools

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers usually join through campus or walk-in drives of outsourcing and shared-service centres, followed by process training. Basic accounting knowledge and comfort with Excel are tested; some roles involve night shifts for overseas clients.

value.title: At a glance
items: Common next roles: senior associate, team lead, or a move to general accounting or reporting.
Repetitive tasks are increasingly automated, so analysis and exception-handling matter more.
Studying CA, CMA or an accounting certification alongside the job widens options.
